source: Red tide به علت غلظت بالاتر از حد نورمال Karenia brevis که یک ارگانیزم بحری یک حجروی طبیعی است، بوجود می آید.
english_gold: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.
english_hypothesis: Red tide occurs when the concentration of Karenia brevis, a natural marine unicellular organism, exceeds normal levels.

source: فکتور های طبیعی میتواند باهم تقاطع کنند تا شرایط دلخواه را ایجاد کند و به این ترتیب تعداد این الجی بصورت چشمگیری افزایش یابد.
english_gold: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.
english_hypothesis: Natural factors can intersect with each other to create desired conditions, thereby significantly increasing the number of these jets.

source: این الجی نیوروتوکسین را تولید میکند که اعصاب را در هر دو انسان ها و ماهی ها غیرفعال کرده میتواند.
english_gold: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.
english_hypothesis: This jelly produces a neurotoxin that can deactivate nerves in both humans and fish.

source: ماهی ها معمولاً به علت غلظت های بالای توکسین در آب ها میمیرند.
english_gold: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.
english_hypothesis: Fish usually die due to high toxin concentrations in the water.

source: انسان ها با تنفس آب آلوده که توسط باد و امواج به هوا انتقال یافته است، متاثر گردیده میتواند.
english_gold: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
english_hypothesis: People can be affected by breathing contaminated water that has been transferred to the air by wind and waves.

source: برای بازگشت به سطح انرژی قبلی خود، آنها باید انرژی اضافی دریافت شده از آن را از بین ببرند.
english_gold: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.
english_hypothesis: To return to their previous energy level, they must eliminate the excess energy received from it.

source: آنها این کار را با انتشار نور و ذرات کوچک به نام "فوتون" انجام می دهند.
english_gold: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".
english_hypothesis: They do this by emitting light and small particles called "photons."

source: دانشمندان این فرآیند را "انتشار محرک تابش" می نامند زیرا اتوم ها با نور شدید تحریک می شوند ، نور فوتون ها را منتشر می کند و نور نوعی تابش است.
english_gold: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.
english_hypothesis: Scientists call this process "stimulus emission" because atoms are excited by intense light, emit photons, and light is a form of radiation.

source: تصویر بعدی انتشار فوتون های اتومی را نشان می دهد. البته عکسها در واقع بسیار کوچکتر از عکس هستند.
english_gold: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.
english_hypothesis: The next image shows the emission of atomic photons. Of course the photos are actually much smaller than the images.

source: فوتون ها حتی کوچکتر از چیزهایی هستند که اتوم می سازند!
english_gold: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!
english_hypothesis: Photons are even smaller than the things that atoms create!

source: عناصر و ترکیبات می توانند از یک حالت به حالت دیگر تبدیل شده و تغییر نکنند.
english_gold: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
english_hypothesis: Elements and compounds can be converted from one state to another and remain unchanged.

source: گاز نایتروجن هنوز همان خواص نایتروجن مایع را دارد. حالت مایع آن متراکم تر است اما مالیکول های آن هنوز یکسان هستند.
english_gold: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
english_hypothesis: Nitrogen gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. Its liquid state is denser, but its molecules remain the same.

source: آب نمونه ای دیگر است، آب ترکیب دو اتم هیدروجن و یک اتم اکسیجن می باشد.
english_gold: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
english_hypothesis: Water is another sample; water is the combination of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

source: دارای ساختمان مالیکولی یکسان می باشد چه گاز، چه مایع و چه جامد باشد.
english_gold: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
english_hypothesis: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

source: اگرچه حالت فیزیکی آن ممکن تغییر بکند، اما حالت کیمیایی آن ثابت می ماند.
english_gold: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
english_hypothesis: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains constant.

source: این را pH کیمیاوی می نامند. می توانید با استفاده از آب کباب سرخ یک شاخص را تهیه کنید.
english_gold: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
english_hypothesis: They call this chemical pH. You can make an indicator using the water from a grilled kebab.

source: رنگ آب کباب بسته به میزان اسیدی یا اساسی بودن (قلیایی) این ماده کیمیاوی تغییر می کند.
english_gold: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
english_hypothesis: The color of kabab water changes depending on whether this chemical substance is acidic or alkaline.

source: سطح pH با مقدار یونهای هایدروجن (H) در ماده کیمیاوی مورد آزمایش مشخص می شود.
english_gold: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
english_hypothesis: The pH level is determined by the amount of hydrogen ions (H) in the chemical substance being tested.

source: یونهای هایدروجن پروتونهایی هستند که الکترونهای آنها از آنها جدا شده است (زیرا اتومهای هایدروجن دارای یک پروتون و یک الکترون هستند).
english_gold: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
english_hypothesis: Hydrogen ions are protons that have had their electrons removed (because hydrogen atoms have one proton and one electron).

source: این فقط این را تایید نمی کند که حد اقل بعضی از داینسور ها پر داشتند که یک نظریه از قبل رایج شده است، مگر توضیحات را فراهم می سازد که فوسیل ها نمی توانند، مانند رنگ و ترتیب سه بعدی.
english_gold: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
english_hypothesis: This does not merely confirm that at least some dinosaurs were large—a theory that has already become widespread—but provides explanations that fossils cannot, such as color and three‑dimensional arrangement.

source: دانشمندان می گویند که پر های این حیوان در قسمت بالا دارای رنگ نصواری است و در قسمت پائین دارای رنگ کمرنگ زرد یا نارنجی است.
english_gold: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
english_hypothesis: Scientists say that the feathers of this animal in the upper part are iridescent in color, while the lower part is a pale yellow or orange.

source: این یافته همچنان به تکامل پر ها در پرندگان نیز کمک میکند.
english_gold: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
english_hypothesis: This finding also helps the evolution of feathers in birds.

source: اینکه پر ها داینسور دارای یک محور توسعه یافته که بنام رچیز یاد می شوند نیست، بلکه دارای خواص پر ها نیز نیست – خار و موی کوچک – محققان دریافتند که رچیز احتمالا یک انکشاف انقلابی بعدی بود که این یک ویژگی دیگری است.
english_gold: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
english_hypothesis: It is not that dinosaur feathers have a developed axis called a rachis, nor do they possess feather properties—spines and tiny hairs—researchers found that the rachis was probably a next revolutionary development, which is another feature.

source: ساختار پر نشان میدهد که آنها در پرواز استفاده نمی شدند مگر بمنظور تنظیم درجه حرارت یا نمایش. محققان پیشنهاد کردنند که اگرچه این دم یک داینسور جوان است، مگر این نمونه پر های جوان را نشان میدهد نه پر های چوچه را.
english_gold: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
english_hypothesis: The feather structure indicates that they were not used in flight except for regulating temperature or display. Researchers suggested that although this tail is from a young dinosaur, this specimen shows young feathers rather than adult feathers.

source: تاثیر که تیم در تلاش آن بود ممکن به علت قوه موجی میان ماده تاریک کهکشان و ماده تاریک راه شیر باشد.
english_gold: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
english_hypothesis: The effect that the team was trying to achieve might be due to the wave power between the dark matter of the galaxy and the dark matter of the Milky Way.

source: طوریکه مهتاب بالای زمین ضربه وارد میکند، باعث تشکیل امواج می گردد، به همین طور راه شیری بالای کهکشان قوی قوه وارد میکند.
english_gold: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
english_hypothesis: In such a way that the moon above the earth strikes, it causes waves to form, similarly the Milky Way above the galaxy exerts a strong force.

source: دانشمندان توانستند نتیجه گیری نمایند که یک ماده تاریک ماده تاریک دیگری مانند ماده منظم تحت تاثیر قرار دهد.
english_gold: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
english_hypothesis: Scientists were able to conclude that one dark matter influences another dark matter in the same way regular matter does.

source: این تیوری میگوید که بیشترین ماده تاریک اطراف کهکشان در اطراف کهکشان نوع حلقه نور موقعیت دارد و از اجزای کوچک زیاد ساخته شده است.
english_gold: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
english_hypothesis: This theory says that the greatest amount of dark matter around a galaxy is located in a ring of light around the galaxy and is made up of many small components.

source: هم سیانوریک اسید و میلامین در نمونه های ادرار حیوانات که بعد از مصرف غذای ملوس شده شان مردند پیدا شد.
english_gold: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
english_hypothesis: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in the urine samples of animals that died after consuming the processed food.

source: محققین در پوهنتون میگوید، این دو مرکب با هم تعامل میکنند تا کریستال های تشکیل دهد که شاید فعالیت گرده را متوقف نماید.
english_gold: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
english_hypothesis: Researchers at the university say that these two compounds interact with each other to form crystals that may stop pollen activity.

source: محققین کریستال های را مشاهده کرد که در ادرار پشک با علاوه کردن میلامین و سیانوریک اسید بوجود آمده بودند.
english_gold: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
english_hypothesis: Researchers observed crystals that had formed in the puppy’s urine by adding methylene and cyanuric acid.

source: ترکیب این کریستال ها با آنهای که در ادرار حیوانات متأثر شده پیدا شد یکسان بود زمانیکه توسط طیف نما فرو بنفش (FTIR) مقایسه شد.
english_gold: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
english_hypothesis: The combination of these crystals with those found in the urine of affected animals was identical when compared by FTIR spectroscopy.

source: زمانیکه یک گروه کوچک موجودات زنده (یک جمیعت کوچک) از جماعت اصلی که آنها مربوط اش میشود جدا میشود (مثلاً اگر آنها بطرف یک سلسله کوه یا دریا حرکت کنند، یا اگر آنها بطرف یک جزیره جدید حرکت کنند تا بتوانند دوباره به راحتی برگردند) آنها محیط متفاوت را در مقایسه با محیط قبلی شاهد خواهند بود.
english_gold: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
english_hypothesis: When a small group of living beings (a small cohort) separates from the main group to which they belong—such as when they move toward a mountain range or a sea, or when they head toward a new island so they can return easily—they will experience a different environment compared to their previous one.

source: محیط جدید منابع متفاوت و رقیبان متفاوت دارد، از اینرو جمیعت جدید به ویژگی های متفاوت یا سازگاری ها جهت اینکه یک رقیب قوی در مقایسه با چیزی که بودند باشند نیاز دارند.
english_gold: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
english_hypothesis: The new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new community needs different traits or adaptations in order to have a strong competitor compared to what they had before.

source: بالاخره، بعد از هزارها یا حتی میلیون ها سال، دو جمیعت چنان با هم متفاوت خواهند بود که دیگر یک نوع خوانده نخواهند شد.
english_gold: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
english_hypothesis: Finally, after thousands or even millions of years, the two societies will be so different that they will no longer be considered the same type.

source: ما این پروسه را شکل گیری مینامیم، که معنی اش فقط تشکیل یک نوع جدید است. شکل گیری یک نتیجه غیرقابل جلوگیری و یک بخش مهم تکامل است.
english_gold: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
english_hypothesis: We call this process formation, which simply means creating a new type. Formation is an inevitable outcome and a major part of evolution.

source: موزازورهای شکارچیهای اوج زمان خود بودند، بجز موزازورهای دیگر، از هیچ چیزی نمی ترسیدند.
english_gold: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
english_hypothesis: They were the apex predators of their time, and except for other mosasaurs, they feared nothing.

source: الاشه ی طویل اش با بیش از 70 دندان تیغ-مانند، همراه یک ست اضافی در سقف دهانش پرکاری شده بود. به این معنی که هیچ چیزی نمیتواند از مسیر آن راه فرار نماید.
english_gold: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
english_hypothesis: Its long tongue had more than 70 razor‑shaped teeth, and an extra set of them was worked into the roof of its mouth. In other words, nothing can escape its path.

source: دقیقاً نمیفهمیم، اما احتمالاً دارای زبان خاردار بوده، رژیم غذایی آن شامل سنگ پشت ها، ماهیان بزرگ، دیگر انواع موزازورها و حتی ممکن است ادمخوارد بوده باشد.
english_gold: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
english_hypothesis: We don’t know exactly, but it probably had a spiny tongue; its diet included rockfish, large fish, other types of mollusks, and it may even have been a cannibal.

source: این همچنان به هر چیزی که داخل آب میشد حمله میکرد؛ حتی یک دایناسور عظیم الجسه مانند T.rex نظیر اش نخواهد بود.
english_gold: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
english_hypothesis: It would still attack anything that could get into the water; even a gigantic dinosaur like T.rex would not be spared.

source: حشرات اولین حیواناتی بودند که به هوا پرواز کردند. توانایی پرواز به آنها کمک کرد تا به راحتی از دست دشمنان فرار کنند و غذا و جفت خود را با موثریت بیشتری بیابند.
english_gold: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
english_hypothesis: Insects were the first animals to fly. Their ability to fly helped them easily escape from enemies and find food and mates more efficiently.

source: اکثر حشرات دارای مزیت خم کردن بالهایشان در امتداد بدن به عقب می باشند.
english_gold: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
english_hypothesis: Most insects have the advantage of bending their wings backward along the body.

source: این به آنها طیف گسترده تری از مکان های کوچکتر برای پنهان شدن از شکارچیان را میدهد.
english_gold: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
english_hypothesis: This gives them a broader range of smaller places to hide from hunters.

source: امروزه، تنها حشراتي كه نمي توانند بالهای خود را به عقب خم كنند، سنجاقک ها و آسیابک ها می باشند.
english_gold: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
english_hypothesis: Today, the only insects that cannot bend their wings backward are fleas and millipedes.

source: جهان دارای بیش از 5000 زبان مختلف، شامل بیش از بیست زبان با 50 میلیون متکلم یا بیشتر است.
english_gold: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
english_hypothesis: The world has more than 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty languages with 50 million speakers or more.

source: برآورد های متفاوت برای شمار افرادی که به زبان هندی صحبت وجود دارد. تخمین شده است که بین دومین و چهارمین زبان رایج در دنیا باشد.
english_gold: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.
english_hypothesis: There are varying estimates for the number of people who speak Hindi. It is estimated to be the second or fourth most common language in the world.

source: تعداد گویندگان اصلی نظر به شمارش یا عدم شمارش لهجه های نزدیک، متفاوت است.
english_gold: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.
english_hypothesis: The number of main speakers varies depending on whether close dialects are counted or not.

source: اندازه برآوردها از 340 میلیون تا 500 میلیون گوینده در حال تغییر است، و تا حدود 800 میلیون نفر می توانند این زبان را بفهمند.
english_gold: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.
english_hypothesis: The estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and up to about 800 million people could understand this language.

source: هندی و اردو در کلمات مشابه هم استند اما از نگاه خط متفاوت هستند؛ در مکالمات روزمره، گویندگان هردو زبان به سادگی میتوانند یکدیگر را درک کنند.
english_gold: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.
english_hypothesis: Hindi and Urdu share similar words but differ in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can easily understand each other.

source: بینظمی کمبود توجه "یک سندرم عصبی است که سه علامت کلاسیک آن شامل هوس خواهی حواس پرتی و بیش فعالی یا انرژی اضافی است."
english_gold: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".
english_hypothesis: Inattention disorder is a neurological syndrome whose three classic symptoms include hyperactivity, distractibility, and excess energy.

source: این یک معیوبیت یادگیری نیست، این یک بیظمی یادگیری است. این "3 تا 5 درصد از همه کودکان، شاید به اندازه 2 میلیون کودک آمریکایی" را شامل می سازد.
english_gold: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".
english_hypothesis: This is not a learning defect, it is a learning disorder. It includes "3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps about 2 million American children."

source: این کودکان معمولاٌ درگیر مشکلات زیادی می شوند، زیرا برای تحریک مغز خود <درگیر رفتارهای پرخطر، دعوا، و به چالش کشیدن قدرت> می شوند، زیرا مغز آنها با روش های عادی تحریک نمی شود.
english_gold: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.
english_hypothesis: These children usually get into many problems because they engage in risky behaviors, fights, and challenge authority to stimulate their brains, as their brains are not stimulated by normal methods.

source: ADD بر روابط با سایر همسالان تاثیر می گذارد زیرا سایر کودکان نمی توانند درک کنند که چرا آنها به شیوه خود رفتار می کنند یا چرا آنها را به همین شکل می نویسند یا اینکه سطح بلوغ آنها متفاوت است.
english_gold: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.
english_hypothesis: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children cannot understand why they behave in their own way or why they write them in the same way or that their level of maturity is different.

source: داکتر تونی مول توبرکلوز بیشتر مقاوم در مقابل ادویه (XDR-TB) را در ساحه کوازولو-نتال افریقای جنوبی کشف کرد.
english_gold: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
english_hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moul Toberclose discovered greater resistance to spices (XDR-TB) in the KwaZulu-Natal region of South Africa.

source: داکتر مول فکر میکند که بعضی از مریضان ممکن در شفاخانه دچار این مشکل شده باشند و حد اقل دو نفر آنان کارمندان صحی شفاخانه بودنند.
english_gold: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
english_hypothesis: Doctor Moul thinks that some of the patients may have had this problem in the hospital, and at least two of them were hospital health staff.

source: در جریان یک سال یک شخص مصاب شده ممکن 10 تا 15 نفر از نزدیکان خود را مصاب کند.
english_gold: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
english_hypothesis: In the course of a year, one infected person may infect 10 to 15 of their close contacts.

source: اگرچه، فیصدی XDR-TB در تمام گروپ از اشخاص دارای توبرکلوز هنوز هم کمتر بنظر میرسد؛ از جمله 330,000 نفر 6,000 نفر در هر لحظه در افریقای جنوبی به این مرض مبتلا شده اند.
english_gold: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
english_hypothesis: Although the percentage of XDR‑TB among all groups of people with tuberculosis still seems lower; for example, 330,000 people, 6,000 people at any moment in South Africa have been affected by this disease.

source: اولین قضایای این مرض درین فصل در اواخر ماه جولای گزارش داده شده است.
english_gold: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
english_hypothesis: The first cases of this disease in this season were reported in late July.

source: این مرض توسط خوک ها انتقال میشود که بعداً توسط پشه ها به انسانان منتقل میشود.
english_gold: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
english_hypothesis: This disease is transmitted by pigs, which later is transmitted to humans by mosquitoes.

source: این شیوع باعث گردیده است تا دولت هندوستان گیرنده گان خوک را در ساحات شدیداً متأثر شده اعزام کند و هزاران پرده پشه و سپری آفت کش ها را توزیع کند.
english_gold: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
english_hypothesis: This outbreak has prompted the Indian government to dispatch pig recipients to severely affected areas and distribute thousands of mosquito nets and pest‑control barriers.

source: پلان های انتقال واکسین به ساحات بیشتر متأثر شده از نظر تاریخ امسال به علت کمبود بودجه و اولویت بندی کم نسبت به سایر امراض به تعویق افتاد.
english_gold: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
english_hypothesis: The plans to transfer the vaccine to more sites have been more affected this year due to budget shortages and lower prioritization compared to other diseases, and have been postponed.

source: یکی از رایج ترین روش هایی که برای نشان دادن اهمیت جامعه گرایی مورد استفاده قرار می گیرد، استفاده از چند مورد ناگوار کودکانی است که از طریق غفلت، بدبختی یا سوء استفاده عمدی، توسط بزرگسالان درحین رشد اجتماعی نشده اند.
english_gold: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
english_hypothesis: One of the most common ways used to demonstrate the importance of collectivism is the use of several unfortunate cases of children who, through neglect, misfortune, or intentional abuse, have not been socially raised by adults.

source: چنین کودکانی بی فرهنگ یا "وحشی" نامیده می شوند. برخی از کودکان بی فرهنگ توسط افراد (معمولاٌ والدین خودشان) حبس شده اند. در بعضی قضایا رها کردن کودک به علت نادیده گرفتن والدین از نقص فکری یا جسمی کودک می باشد.
english_gold: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
english_hypothesis: Such children are called uncultured or "wild." Some uncultured children are imprisoned by people (usually their own parents). In some cases, releasing the child is due to parents ignoring the child's mental or physical deficiencies.

source: کودکان وحشی ممکن است قبل از رها شدن یا فرار، کودک آزاری یا ضربه شدیدی را تجربه کرده باشند.
english_gold: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
english_hypothesis: Wild children may have experienced abuse or severe injury before being released or escaping.

source: به گفته ای بعضی ها توسط حیوانات بزرگ شده اند. گفته می شود برخی به تنهایی در طبیعت زندگی می کردند.
english_gold: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
english_hypothesis: According to some, they were raised by animals. It is said that some lived alone in nature.

source: کودکان که در پرورشگاه قرار میگیرند به دلایل مختلفی از نادیده گرفته شدن تا سوء استفاده جنسی و حتی به زور گیری را شامل می شود.

english_hypothesis: Children who are placed in orphanages are subjected to a range of abuses, from neglect to sexual exploitation and even forced labor.

source: هیچ کودکی نباید در محیطی بزرگ شود که تربیتی، مراقبتی و آموزشی نباشد، اما اینطور است.

english_hypothesis: No child should grow up in an environment that lacks training, care, and education, but that is how it is.

source: ما سیستم پرورشگاه را یک ساحه امن برای این کودکان می دانیم.
english_gold: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
english_hypothesis: We consider the nursery system a safe area for these children.

source: سیستم پرورشگاه ما قرار است جاهای امن، مراقبین مهربان، آموزش پایدار و مراقبت های بهداشتی قابل اعتماد را پیشکش نماید.

english_hypothesis: Our nursery system is intended to offer safe places, caring guardians, sustainable education, and reliable health care.

english_hypothesis: The nursery is expected to provide all the needs that were taken from the house before.

source: همه در جامعه اشتراک می کنند و از سیستم های ترانسپورت استفاده می کنند. تقریباً همه از سیستم های ترانسپورت شکایت دارند.

english_hypothesis: Everyone shares in society and uses transport systems. Almost everyone complains about transport systems.

english_hypothesis: In developed countries, you rarely hear complaints about water quality or bridge collapses.

english_hypothesis: Why do transport systems generate such complaints, why are they inefficient every day? Are transport engineers incompetent? Or is there a more fundamental issue?

source: بدبختانه، مطالعه جریان ترافیک دشوار است زیرا رفتار دریورها با اطمینان صد فیصد قابل پیش بینی نمی باشد.

english_hypothesis: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because river behavior is not 100% predictable.

source: بعد از ظهر روز چهارشنبه، هواکش های ذخیره باز هم احتمالاً از چک وال حرارتی داخل ذخیره لیکی داشتند.

source: بودیزم تبتی مبتنی بر آموزه های بودا است، اما توسط مسیر عشق ماهایانا و با تکنیک های زیادی از یوگای هندی گسترش یافت.

english_hypothesis: Buddhism in Tibet is very simple. It includes Kundalini yoga, meditation, and the all‑encompassing path of love.

source: با کوندالینی یوگا، انرژی کوندالینی (انرژی روشنگری) از طریق وضعیت های یوگا، تمرینات تنفسی، مانتراها و تجسم ها بیدار می شود.

english_hypothesis: With Kundalini yoga, the Kundalini energy (the energy of enlightenment) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras, and visualizations.

source: مرکز مدیتیشن تبتی یوگای خدایی است. از طریق تجسم خدایان مختلف، کانال های انرژی پاک میشوند، چاکراها فعال میشوند و آگاهی روشنگری ایجاد می شوند.

source: جریان ترافیک مطالعه حرکت دریوران و وسایل نقلیه بین دو نقطه و تعاملات آنها با یکدیگر است.

source: برای نشان دادن بهتر جریان ترافیک، روابط بین سه ویژگی اصلی آن ایجاد شده است: (1) جریان، (2) تراکم، و (3) سرعت.

source: اگرچه هوش مصنوعی دارای مفهوم علمی تخیلی قوی می باشد، اما هوش مصنوعی شاخه بسیار مهمی از کمپیوترساینس را تشکیل می دهد، که با رفتار، یادگیری و سازگاری هوشمند در ماشین سر و کار دارد.

english_gold: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
english_hypothesis: Hong Kong Island has given its name to the Hong Kong territory and is a place that many tourists consider the main focus.

source: قسمت بزرگی از انکشاف شهری جزیره هانگ کانگ به صورت متراکم در زمین های احیا شده در امتداد ساحل شمالی قرار دارد.
english_gold: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
english_hypothesis: A large portion of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely built on revitalized land along the northern coast.

source: جلوه ساختمان هایی که خط افق هنگ کنگ را می سازد به بار چارتی درخشان تشبیه شده می شود که با حضور آبهای بندر ویکتوریا ظاهر می گردد.
english_gold: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
english_hypothesis: The silhouette of the buildings that form Hong Kong’s skyline is likened to a brilliant chart that appears with the presence of Victoria Harbour waters.

source: برای دیدن بهترین مناظر هانگ کانگ، جزیره را ترک کرده به سمت ساحل کولون در سمت مخالف بروید.
english_gold: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
english_hypothesis: To see the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head toward the opposite side of the Kowloon coast.

source: ساندربان ها بزرگترین کمربند درختان ساحلی حرا در جهان می باشد که به طول 80 کیلومتر (50 مایل) به مناطق داخلی بنگلادیش و هند امتداد یافته است.
english_gold: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
english_hypothesis: The Sunderban is the largest mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 kilometers (50 miles) into the interior of Bangladesh and India.

source: ساندربان ها به حیث ساحه میراث جهانی یونسکو اعلام شده است. قسمتی از جنگل در قلمرو هند، پارک ملی ساندربانس نامیده می شود.
english_gold: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
english_hypothesis: Sandbans have been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. A part of the forest in the Indian territory is called Sandbans National Park.

source: با این حال جنگل ها تنها باتلاقهای حرا نیستند - آنها شامل برخی از آخرین بقایای جنگل های بزرگ هستند که زمانی دشت گنگتیک را پوشانیده بودند.
english_gold: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
english_hypothesis: However, forests are not just the marshes of Harra—they also include some of the last remnants of the great forests that once covered the Gengteik plain.

source: ساندربان ها مساحتی در حدود 3850 کیلومتر مربع را پوشانیده اند که تقریباً یک سوم حصه آن را مناطق آبی/باتلاقی پوشانیده است.
english_gold: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
english_hypothesis: Sandraban has covered an area of about 3,850 square kilometers, of which roughly one third is covered by wetland/ marshy areas.

source: از سال 1966، ساندربان ها پناهگاه حیات وحش بوده اند و تخمین زده می شود که در حال حاضر 400 ببر رویال بنگال و حدود 30،000 گوزن خالدار در منطقه موجود می باشد.
english_gold: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
english_hypothesis: Since 1966, sandbanks have served as a wildlife refuge, and it is estimated that there are currently 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.

source: سانسکریت یک زبان قدیمی و با زبان لاتینی که در اروپا صحبت می شود قابل مقایسه است.
english_gold: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.
english_hypothesis: Sanskrit is an ancient language and can be compared with the Latin language spoken in Europe.

source: در مورد چگونگی پیدایش سانسکریت تیوری های زیادی وجود دارد. یکی از آنها درمورد مهاجرت آریایی به هند از غرب است که زبان خود را با خود آورده بودند.
english_gold: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.
english_hypothesis: There are many theories about how Sanskrit originated. One of them concerns the migration of the Aryans to India from the west, bringing their language with them.

source: اولین کتاب شناخته شده در جهان به زبان سانسکریت نوشته شده است. پس از تکمیل اوپانیشادها، سانسکریت بنابر تغییر سلسله ها از بین رفت.
english_gold: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.
english_hypothesis: The first known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the completion of the Upanishads, Sanskrit disappeared due to changes in dynasties.

source: سانسکریت یک زبان خیلی پیچیده و کاملی است که بعنوان منبع خادم خیلی زبان های جدید هندی بوده است، دقیقاٌ همانند زبان لاتین که منبع زبان های اروپایی مانند فرانسوی و اسپانیایی است.
english_gold: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
english_hypothesis: Sanskrit is a very complex and complete language that has served as a source for many new Indian languages, just as Latin has been the source for European languages such as French and Spanish.

source: در قرن 15-پانزدهم، استونیای شمالی تحت تاثیر فرهنگی شدیدی آلمانی قرار داشت.
english_gold: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.
english_hypothesis: In the 15th century, northern Estonia was under strong German cultural influence.

source: بعضی از صومعه نشینان آلمانی میخواستند خدا را به مردم بومی نزدیک بسازند، بناً زبان ساده ای استونیایی را ابداع کردند.
english_gold: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.
english_hypothesis: Some German monks wanted to make God close to the native people, so they invented a simple Estonian language.

source: طبق الفبای آلمانی بود و یک کرکتر "Õ/õ" اضافه شد.
english_gold: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.
english_hypothesis: It followed the German alphabet, and a character "Õ/õ" was added.

source: با گذشت زمان، بسیاری از کلمات که از زبان آلمانی قرض گرفته شده بود با هم مدغم شدند. این شروع روشنگری بود.
english_gold: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.
english_hypothesis: With time, many of the words that had been borrowed from German were assimilated together. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

source: سیکیزم دینی از شبه قاره هند است. در طول قرن 15هم در منطقه پنجاب از یک انشعاب فرقه ای از مراسم هندو سرچشمه گرفت.
english_gold: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
english_hypothesis: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian subcontinent. During the 15th century, in the Punjab region, it originated from a sectarian offshoot of Hindu rituals.

source: سیک ها ایمان خود را دینی جدا از هندویسم می دانند، اگرچه ریشه ها و رسم و رواج های هندوی آن را تصدیق می کنند.
english_gold: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
english_hypothesis: Sikhs consider their faith a religion distinct from Hinduism, even though they acknowledge its roots and customs.

source: سیک ها دین خود را گورمات می نامند که در پنجابی به معنای "راه گورو" است. گورو جنبه اساسی همه ادیان هندی است، اما در آیین سیک اهمیتی پیدا کرده است که هسته اعتقادات سیک را تشکیل می دهد.
english_gold: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
english_hypothesis: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which in Punjabi means “the Guru’s way.” The Guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions, but in Sikhism it has become a central element that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

source: این دین در قرن 15هم توسط گورو ناناک (1539-1469) پایه گذاری شد. به دنبال آن (نه) گورو ای دیگر وجود داشت.
english_gold: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
english_hypothesis: This religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1539-1469). After that, there was no other Guru.

source: محیط نظامی امپراتوری روم به توسعه پیشرفت های پزشکی کمک کرد.
english_gold: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
english_hypothesis: The military environment of the Roman Empire helped the development of medical advancements.

source: داکتران توسط امپراتور اگستوس استخدام شدند و حتی اولین سپاه طبی رومی را برای استفاده در عواقب نبردها تشکیل دادند.
english_gold: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
english_hypothesis: Doctors were hired by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman medical corps to be used in the aftermath of battles.

source: جراحان از داروهای آرام بخش مختلف از جمله مورفین از عصاره دانه های خشخاش و اسکوپولامین از دانه های هربان آگاهی داشتند.
english_gold: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
english_hypothesis: Surgeons were aware of various sedatives, including morphine from poppy seed extracts and scopolamine from henbane seeds.

source: آنها در قطع عضو برای نجات مریضان از قانقاریا و همچنین استفاده از تورنیکت و گیره شریانی برای جلوگیری از جریان خود مهارت پیدا کردند.
english_gold: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
english_hypothesis: They became skilled in performing amputations to save patients from hemorrhage, and also in using tourniquets and arterial clamps to prevent bleeding.

source: در طی چندین قرن،امپراتوری روم به دستاوردهای عظیمی در زمینه طبابت منجر شد و بسیاری از دانشی را که امروز می شناسیم، تشکیل داد.
english_gold: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
english_hypothesis: During several centuries, the Roman Empire led to great achievements in medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

source: برای مدتی طولانی در طول قرن نوزدهم و بیستم، باور بر این بود که اولین ساکنان نیوزلند مردم مائوری بودند که پرندگان عظیم الجثه بنام مواس را شکار می نمودند.
english_gold: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
english_hypothesis: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed that the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Māori people, who hunted the large birds called moa.

source: سپس این تئوری این نظریه را شکل داد که مردم مائوری با تعداد زیادی کشتی از پولینیشیا مهاجرت کردند و نیوزلند را از موریوری گرفتند و جامعه ای زراعت کار را بنیاد نهادند.
english_gold: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
english_hypothesis: Then this theory formed that the Māori people migrated with many ships from Polynesia, took New Zealand from the Moriori, and founded an agricultural society.

source: با این حال، شواهد جدید حاکی از آن است که موریوری گروهی از سرزمین اصلی مائوری بودند که از نیوزلند به جزایر چاتهام مهاجرت کرده و فرهنگ متمایز و مسالمت آمیز خود را توسعه دادند.
english_gold: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
english_hypothesis: However, new evidence indicates that the Māori were a group of people from the original Māori homeland who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands and developed their distinct, peaceful culture.

source: قبیله دیگری نیز در جزایر چاتهام وجود داشت، اینها مائوری ها بودند که از نیوزلند مهاجرت کرده بودند.
english_gold: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
english_hypothesis: There was another tribe on the Chatham Islands; they were the Māori who had migrated from New Zealand.

source: آنها خود را موریوری نامیدند، چندین کشمکش بین آنها رخ داد و در نهایت، موریوری از بین رفت.
english_gold: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
english_hypothesis: They called themselves Moriori, several conflicts occurred among them, and in the end, the Moriori disappeared.

source: مدنیت یک فرهنگ جداگانه است که بین گروه بزرگی از مردم که در یک جامعه زندگی و کار میکنند مشترک است.
english_gold: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
english_hypothesis: Citizenship is a distinct culture that is shared among a large group of people who live and work in a society.

source: کلمه civilization از civil لاتین که در لاتین civis به معنی شهروند و civitas به معنای شهر یا شهر-دولت می آید و این نیز گرچه اندازه جامعه را مشخص می کند.
english_gold: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
english_hypothesis: The word civilization comes from the Latin civil, which in Latin civis means citizen and civitas means city or city-state, and this also, although it specifies the size of society.

source: دولت شهرها اجداد ملت ها هستند. یک فرهنگ مدنی مستلزم انتقال دانش از چندین نسل است، نشانه های فرهنگی جاودان و پخش عادلانه.
english_gold: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
english_hypothesis: The governments of cities are the ancestors of peoples. A civil culture requires the transmission of knowledge across several generations, eternal cultural signs, and fair distribution.

source: فرهنگ های کوچک اغلب بدون به جا گذاشتن آثار تاریخی مرتبط ناپدید می شوند و به عنوان تمدن های خاص شناخته نمی شوند.
english_gold: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
english_hypothesis: Small cultures often disappear without leaving related historical artifacts and are not recognized as distinct civilizations.

source: خطوط واگن در اوایل قرن شانزدهم در انگلستان ساخته شدند.
english_gold: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
english_hypothesis: Wagon lines were built in early sixteenth century in England.

source: گرچه خطوط واگن فقط از تخته چوب های موازی تشکیل شده بودند، اما به اسب هایی که آن ها را می کشیدند امکان می داد به سرعت بیشتری رسیده و بارهای بیشتری را نسبت به جاده های ناهموار آن زمان بکشند.
english_gold: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
english_hypothesis: Although the wagon tracks were made only of parallel wooden planks, they allowed the horses that pulled them to reach greater speeds and haul more loads than the uneven roads of that time.

source: این به عملی معمول تبدیل شد، اما آهن سبب ساییدگی بیشتر چرخ های چوبی واگن گردید.
english_gold: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
english_hypothesis: This became a common practice, but iron caused more wear on the wooden wagon wheels.

source: سرانجام چرخ های چوبی با چرخ های آهنی جایگزین شدند. در سال 1767، اولین خطوط ریل کاملاً فولادی معرفی شدند.
english_gold: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
english_hypothesis: Finally, wooden wheels were replaced with iron wheels. In 1767, the first fully steel rail lines were introduced.

source: گوارانی ها مهمترین گروه بومی ساکن پاراگوئه شرقی امروزی بودند و به عنوان شکارچیان نیمه کوچی زندگی می کردند که برای معیشت زراعت نیز انجام می دادند.
english_gold: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
english_hypothesis: The Guarani were the most important indigenous group living in what is now eastern Paraguay, and they lived as semi-nomadic hunters who also practiced agriculture for their livelihood.

source: منطقه چاکو محل اقامت گروه های دیگری از قبایل بومی مانند گایاکوری و پایاگوآ بود که با شکار، جمع کردن و ماهیگیری دوام آوردند.
english_gold: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
english_hypothesis: The Chaku area was the home of other indigenous tribal groups such as the Gaiakori and Payaguá, who survived through hunting, gathering, and fishing.

source: در قرن 16، پاراگوئه که قبلاً "ولایت عظیم بومیان" نامیده می شد، در نتیجه تقابل فاتحان اسپانیایی با گروه های بومی به وجود آمد.
english_gold: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
english_hypothesis: In the 16th century, Paraguay, which had previously been called the "Great Native Province," came into existence as a result of the clash between Spanish conquerors and indigenous groups.

source: اسپانیایی ها دوره استعماری را آغاز کردند که سه قرن به طول انجامید.
english_gold: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
english_hypothesis: The Spaniards began the colonial period, which lasted three centuries.

source: هرگونه اردو زدن پایینتر از لبه گردند کانیون نیازمند به کسب مجوز می باشد.
english_gold: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.
english_hypothesis: Any encampment below the rim of the canyon requires a permit.

source: مجوزها برای محافظت از دره محدود است و در اولین روز ماه، چهار ماه قبل از ماه اول، در دسترس قرار می گیرد.
english_gold: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.
english_hypothesis: The permits for protecting the valley are limited and are made available on the first day of the month, four months before the first month.

source: بنابراین، مجوز رفتن به این مناطق برای هر یک از تاریخهای ماه می، از یکم ماه جنوری آغاز صادر می گردد.
english_gold: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.
english_hypothesis: Therefore, the permit to enter these areas for each of the dates in May is issued starting from January 1.

source: فضای محبوب ترین مناطق، مانند اردوگاه Bright Angel در مجاورت Phantom Ranch، به طور کلی با درخواست های دریافت شده در اولین تاریخ که برای رزرو باز می شود، پر می گردد.
english_gold: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.
english_hypothesis: The most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Camp near Phantom Ranch, are generally filled with requests received on the first date that opens for reservation.

source: این شهر دقیقاً در کنار آبشارها قرار دارد و آنها جاذبه اصلی آن هستند، اما این مقصد گردشگری محبوب برای اقامت طولانی مدت فرصت های زیادی را برای ماجراجویان و منظره گردان ارائه می دهد.
english_gold: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.
english_hypothesis: This city is located right beside the waterfalls, which are its main attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers many opportunities for adventurers and sightseers for long-term stays.

source: در فصل بارانی (نوامبر تا مارچ)، حجم آب بالاتر و آبشار مهیج تر خواهد بود.
english_gold: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.
english_hypothesis: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the waterfall more exciting.

source: اگر از روی پل عبور کنید یا در امتداد مسیرهایی که در نزدیکی آبشارها پیچیده اند قدم بزنید، خیس می شوید.
english_gold: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.
english_hypothesis: If you cross the bridge or walk along the winding paths near the waterfalls, you will get wet.

source: از طرف دیگر، دقیقاً به این دلیل است که حجم آب آنقدر زیاد است که مشاهده شما از آبشارهای واقعی - با وجود آن همه آب - مبهم می شود!
english_gold: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
english_hypothesis: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so great that your view of real waterfalls—despite all that water—becomes blurred!

source: این کوه شیب دار در منتهی الیه شمالی ماچوپیچو قد کشیده است، که اغلب پس زمینه بسیاری عکس ها از ویرانه ها می باشد.
english_gold: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
english_hypothesis: This steep mountain is located at the northern terminus of Machu Picchu, and it is often the background in many photos of the ruins.

source: از پایین کمی دلهره آور به نظر می رسد و صعودی شیب دار و دشوار است، اما بیشتر افراد دارای تناسب اندام نسبی می توانند در حدود 45 دقیقه این مسیر را طی کنند.
english_gold: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.
english_hypothesis: It looks a little intimidating from below, and the ascent is steep and difficult, but most people with a relatively fit physique can cover the route in about 45 minutes.

source: زینه های سنگی در امتداد قسمت بیشتر مسیر قرار داده شده است و در قسمت های شیبدارتر کیبل های فولادی دستگیره ای حمایوی فراهم می کنند.
english_gold: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.
english_hypothesis: Stone piles have been placed along most of the route, and in the steeper sections, steel cable handholds provide support.

source: با این اوصاف، انتظار کم نفس شدن را داشته باشید و در قسمت های شیبدار، بخصوص هنگام تر بودن مراقب باشید، زیرا می تواند به سرعت خطرناک شود.
english_gold: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.
english_hypothesis: With these circumstances, expect a decrease in breathlessness and be cautious in the more dangerous areas, especially when it is hot, because it can become dangerous quickly.

source: یک مغاره کوچک در نزدیکی قسمت بالایی وجود دارد که باید از آن عبور کرد، این مغاره بسیار کم ارتفاع و تنگ است.
english_gold: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
english_hypothesis: There is a small cave near the upper part that must be passed through; it is very low and narrow.

source: پیاده روی فعالیتی در فضای باز است که شامل پیاده روی در محیط های طبیعی، اغلب در مسیرهای پیاده روی می شود.
english_gold: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
english_hypothesis: Walking is an outdoor activity that involves walking in natural environments, usually on walking paths.

source: پیاده روی روزانه شامل مسافتهای کمتر از یک مایل تا مسافتهای طولانی تر است که می توان در یک روز طی کرد.
english_gold: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
english_hypothesis: Daily walking includes distances of less than one mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

source: برای پیاده روی یک روزه در مسیری آسان به آمادگی های کمی نیاز است و هر فردی با تناسب اندام متوسط می تواند از آن لذت ببرد.
english_gold: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
english_hypothesis: A one‑day walk on an easy trail requires only minimal preparation, and anyone with average fitness can enjoy it.

source: فامیل هایی که اطفال کوچک دارند ممکن به آمادگی بیشتری نیاز داشته باشند، اما یک روز بیرون از خانه حتی با نوزادان و اطفال مهد کودک به راحتی امکان پذیر است.
english_gold: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
english_hypothesis: Families with young children may need more preparation, but it is easy to go outside one day even with infants and preschoolers.

source: گرچه بسیاری از حیوانات موجود در پارک به دیدن انسان عادت دارند، با این وجود حیوانات وحشی هستند و نباید به آنها غذا داده شود یا مزاحمتی برای آنها ایجاد گردد.
english_gold: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
english_hypothesis: Although many of the animals in the park are accustomed to seeing humans, they are still wild and should not be fed or disturbed.

source: به گفته مقامات پارک، باید حداقل 100 یارد/متر از خرس و گرگ و 25 یارد/متر از دیگر حیوانات وحشی فاصله داشته باشید!
english_gold: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
english_hypothesis: According to park officials, you must keep a minimum distance of 100 yards/meters from bears and wolves, and 25 yards/meters from other wild animals.

source: مهم نیست که چقدر مطیع به نظر برسند، گاومیش، گوزن، گوزن شمالی، خرس و تقریباً همه حیوانات بزرگ می توانند حمله ور شوند.
english_gold: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
english_hypothesis: It doesn't matter how obedient they may appear; buffalo, deer, moose, bears, and almost all large animals can be aggressive.

source: سالانه ده ها نفر از بازدیدکنندگان به دلیل عدم رعایت فاصله مناسب مجروح می شوند. این حیوانات، بزرگ، وحشی و بالقوه خطرناک هستند، بنابراین فضای لازم را به آنها بدهید.
english_gold: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
english_hypothesis: Every year, dozens of visitors are injured because they do not maintain proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them the space they need.

source: علاوه بر این، توجه داشته باشید که بوها، خرس ها و سایر حیوانات وحشی را به خود جذب می کنند، بنابراین از حمل یا پخت غذاهای معطر خودداری کرده و چادری پاکیزه داشته باشید.
english_gold: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
english_hypothesis: In addition, note that the scent attracts bears, wolves, and other wild animals, so avoid carrying or cooking fragrant foods and keep a clean blanket.

source: هرکسی که قصد دارد در ارتفاعات بالا یا بر فراز کوه ها دریوری کند، باید احتمال بارش برف، یخ یا یخبندان را در نظر بگیرد.
english_gold: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
english_hypothesis: Anyone who intends to hike in high elevations or above the mountains must consider the likelihood of snowfall, ice, or glaciers.

source: در جاده های یخی و برفی، اصطکاک کم است و نمی توانید مانند آسفالت لخت دریوری کنید.
english_gold: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
english_hypothesis: On icy and snowy roads, friction is low and you cannot drive like on bare asphalt.

source: در هنگام کولاک، ممکن در زمانی کوتاه برف کافی برای گیر افتادن شما ببارد.
english_gold: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
english_hypothesis: During a blizzard, it may snow enough in a short time to trap you.

source: ممکن ساحه دید نیز با افتادن یا وزیدن برف یا با تراکم یا یخ روی شیشه های موتر محدود شود.
english_gold: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
english_hypothesis: The visibility range may also be limited by falling or blowing snow, or by accumulation or ice on the car windows.

source: از سوی دیگر، شرایط یخی و برفی در بسیاری از کشورها عادی است و ترافیک عمدتاً بدون وقفه در تمام طول سال ادامه دارد.
english_gold: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
english_hypothesis: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic continues largely uninterrupted throughout the year.

source: گردش های اکتشافی ها شاید بزرگترین جاذبه گردشگری در آفریقا و نقطه عطف برای بسیاری از بازدیدکنندگان باشد.
english_gold: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
english_hypothesis: Exploratory tours may be the biggest tourist attraction in Africa and a turning point for many visitors.

source: اصطلاح گردش اکتشافی در استفاده عمومی به سفرهای زمینی برای مشاهده حیات وحش خیره کننده آفریقا، به ویژه در ساوانا اشاره دارد.
english_gold: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
english_hypothesis: The term "exploratory travel" in general use refers to land trips to observe Africa's breathtaking wildlife, especially in the savanna.

source: برخی از حیوانات، مانند فیل ها و زرافه ها، تمایل دارند به موتر ها نزدیک شوند و تجهیزات استندرد امکان مشاهده خوب را فراهم می کند.
english_gold: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
english_hypothesis: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach the vehicles, and the standard equipment provides good viewing opportunities.

source: شیرها، یوزپلنگ ها و پلنگ ها گاهی خجالتی هستند و با دوربین دو چشمی آنها را بهتر خواهید دید.
english_gold: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
english_hypothesis: Lions, leopards, and tigers can sometimes be shy, and you’ll see them better with binoculars.

source: یک گردشگری تفریحی پیاده (همچنین "پیاده روی در بوته" ، "سافاری پیاده روی" یا "پیاده روی" نامیده می شود) شامل پیاده روی چند ساعته یا چند روزه است.
english_gold: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
english_hypothesis: A recreational walking tour (also called "walking in the bush," "walking safari," or "hiking") involves several hours or several days of walking.

source: بیگ گردی با اسکی: همچنین این فعالیت اسکی در مناطق دورافتاده، تور اسکی یا پیاده روی اسکی نیز گفته می شود.
english_gold: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
english_hypothesis: Ski trekking: this skiing activity in remote areas, ski tours, or ski hikes is also referred to as.

source: این امر مربوط به تور اسکی یا کوهنوردی به سبک آلپ است اما معمولاً شامل این موارد نمی شود، دومی که در زمین های شیبدار انجام می شود و نیاز به اسکی و موزه های بسیار سخت تری دارد.
english_gold: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
english_hypothesis: This refers to a ski or alpine-style mountaineering tour, but it usually does not include these items; the second is done in steep terrain and requires much harder skiing and more difficult museums.

source: به مسیر اسکی به عنوان یک مسیر پیاده روی مشابه بیاندیشید.
english_gold: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
english_hypothesis: Think of the ski trail as a similar walking path.

source: در شرایط خوب می توانید مسافت های بیشتری را به نسبت پیاده روی طی کنید - اما به ندرت می توانید سرعت اسکی روی سطح را بدون بیگ پشتی سنگین در مسیرهای آماده به دست آورید.
english_gold: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
english_hypothesis: In good conditions you can cover more distance than on foot – but it is rarely possible to achieve skiing speed on the surface without a heavy backpack on prepared trails.

source: پالیسی بیمه را کاپی کنید و کاپی بیمه نامه و معلومات تماس شرکت بیمه خود را همراه خود داشته باشید.
english_gold: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
english_hypothesis: Copy the insurance policy and keep a copy of the policy and the contact information of your insurance company with you.

source: آنها برای مشاوره/مجوزها و ایراد دعوی باید آدرس ایمیل شرکت بیمه و شماره تلیفون های بین المللی را نشان دهند.
english_gold: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
english_hypothesis: They must provide the insurance company's email address and international phone numbers for consultation/permits and claim disputes.

source: کاپی دیگری در بکس خود و به صورت آنلاین داشته باشید (با پیوست به خودتان ایمیل کنید، یا ذخیره در "کلود").
english_gold: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
english_hypothesis: Have another copy in your inbox and online (attach it to yourself via email, or save it in the cloud).

source: اگر با لپ تاپ یا تبلت سفر می کنید، یک نسخه را در مموری یا دیسک آن ذخیره کنید (قابل دسترس بدون اینترنت).
english_gold: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
english_hypothesis: If you travel with a laptop or tablet, save a copy on its memory or disk (accessible without internet).

source: همچنین کاپی پالیسی/تماس را به همراهان سفر و اقوام یا دوستان مایل به کمک در مبدا بدهید.
english_gold: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
english_hypothesis: Also provide a copy of the policy/contact to your travel companions and to relatives or friends who are willing to help at the departure point.

source: در هنگام بار بردن برای دیگران - هرگز بیگ های خود را از جلوی چشمتان دور نکنید، به ویژه هنگامی که از مرزهای بین المللی عبور می نمایید.
english_gold: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.
english_hypothesis: When carrying loads for others, never look away from your own bags, especially when crossing international borders.

source: شما می توانید بدون اطلاع خود به عنوان حامل مواد مخدر مورد استفاده قرار بگیرید، که دردسرهای فراوانی برای شما ایجاد خواهد کرد.
english_gold: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.
english_hypothesis: You may be used as a drug user without your knowledge, which will cause you many troubles.

source: این روند شامل انتظار در صف است، زیرا سگ های مواد یاب در هر زمانی ممکن بدون اطلاع قبلی استفاده شود.
english_gold: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.
english_hypothesis: This process involves waiting in line, because drug-sniffing dogs may be used at any time without prior notice.

source: بیگ های بدون صاحب هدف سرقت هستند و همچنین می توانند توجه مقامات را در مورد تهدید بمبگذاری جلب کنند.
english_gold: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.
english_hypothesis: Beggar without a master is a thief and can also draw officials’ attention to bomb threats.

source: صبح شکم خود را با یک قهوه غنی و شب با یک چای آرام بخش بابونه پر کنید.
english_gold: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.
english_hypothesis: Fill your stomach in the morning with a rich coffee and at night with a calming chamomile tea.

source: هنگام اقامت، فرصت دارید به خودتان برسید و چند دقیقه ای اضافه وقت بگذارید تا چیز خاصی را دم کنید.
english_gold: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.
english_hypothesis: During your stay, you have the opportunity to unwind and spend a few extra minutes brewing something special.

source: اگر احساس می کنید ماجراجو هستید، از فرصت استفاده کرده و برخی تسکین دهنده ها را خورده یا مخلوط کنید:
english_gold: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:
english_hypothesis: If you feel adventurous, take advantage of the opportunity and eat or mix some soothing ones.

source: شاید یک نوشیدنی ساده پیدا کنید که می توانید برای صبحانه پس از بازگشت به برنامه روزانه خود، آن را تهیه نمایید.
english_gold: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.
english_hypothesis: You might find a simple drink that you can prepare for breakfast after returning to your daily routine.

source: خانم ها: توصیه می شود که تمام مسافران خانم بدون در نظر گرفتن وضعیت تأهل واقعیشان، خود را متاهل بگویند.
english_gold: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
english_hypothesis: Ladies: It is recommended that all female passengers, regardless of their actual marital status, declare themselves married.

source: استفاده از انگشتر نیز مفید است (نه انگشتری که خیلی قیمتی به نظر برسد.)
english_gold: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
english_hypothesis: Using a ring is also useful (not a ring that looks very expensive).

source: زنان میبایست درک کنند تفاوت های فرهنگی ممکن منجر به چیزی که آنها آزار و اذیت می دانند گردد و تعقیب شدن یا از بازو گرفته شدن و غیرمعمول نمی باشد.
english_gold: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
english_hypothesis: Women must understand that cultural differences can lead to what they consider harassment, and that being pursued or grabbed by the arm is not unusual.

source: در پس زدن مردان قاطع باشید و از ایستادگی بر موقف خود نترسید (تفاوت های فرهنگی یا غیره، درستش نمیکند!).
english_gold: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
english_hypothesis: Be decisive in confronting men and do not fear standing your ground (cultural differences or otherwise, it doesn’t fix it!).

source: اکوادور مقرر کرده است که شهروندان کوبایی باید قبل از ورود به اکوادور از طریق فرودگاه‌های بین‌المللی یا نقاط پذیرش مرزی دعوت نامه دریافت کنند.
english_gold: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.
english_hypothesis: Ecuador has stipulated that Cuban citizens must obtain an invitation before entering Ecuador through international airports or border reception points.

source: این نامه باید توسط وزارت امور خارجه اکوادور به رسمیت شناخته شده و با الزاماتی خاص مطابقت کند.
english_gold: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.
english_hypothesis: This letter must be recognized by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ecuador and comply with specific requirements.

source: این الزامات برای ایجاد جریان مهاجرت سازمان‌ یافته بین دو کشور طراحی شده‌اند.
english_gold: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.
english_hypothesis: These requirements are designed to create a flow of organized migration between two countries.

source: شهروندان کوبایی که دارنده کارت سبز آمریکا می باشند میبایست برای کسب معافیت از این الزامات به کنسولگری اکوادور مراجعه نمایند.
english_gold: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.
english_hypothesis: Kobay citizens who hold an American green card must go to the Ecuador consulate to obtain an exemption from these requirements.

source: پاسپورت شما باید حداقل 6 ماه بعد از تاریخ سفرتان اعتبار داشته باشد. برای اثبات طول مدت اقامتتان به تکت رفت و برگشت نیاز دارید.
english_gold: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.
english_hypothesis: Your passport must be valid for at least six months beyond the date of your trip. To prove the length of your stay, you need a round‑trip ticket.

source: اگر می خواهید دنیا را از نظر ضرورت، شیوه زندگی یا چالش به صورت ارزان بگردید، راه هایی برای این کار وجود دارد.
english_gold: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.
english_hypothesis: If you want to see the world in terms of necessity, lifestyle, or challenge cheaply, there are ways to do it.

source: اساساً، آنها به دو دسته تقسیم می شوند: یا هنگام مسافرت کار کنید یا سعی کنید هزینه های خود را محدود کنید. این مقاله بر مورد دوم تمرکز دارد.
english_gold: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.
