source: به منظور دریافت معلومات بیشتر در مورد مسابقات و محل خرید تکت مسابقات چوگان، انجمن چوگان آرژانتین را بررسی کنید.
english_gold: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
english_hypothesis: To get more information about the horse races and where to buy race tickets, check the Argentine Horse Racing Association.

source: مدت زیاد قبل از دیلی شو و راپور کولبرت، زمانیکه هیک و جانسن در UW در 1988 محصل بودنند در مورد یک نشریه تصور میکردنند که از اخبار-و گزارش اخبار تقلید کند.
english_gold: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.
english_hypothesis: Long before the Daily Show and the Colbert Report, when Hick and Johnson were students at UW in 1988, they imagined a magazine that would imitate news and news reports.

source: از زمان آغاز آن بدینسو، The Onion با یک نسخه چاپی، یک ویب سایت دارای 5,000,000 بینندگان بی همتا در ماه اکتوبر، اعلانات شخصی، یک شبکه 24 ساعته اخبار، پودکاست ها، و یک اطلس جهانی اخیراً عرضه شده به باراز که بنام Our Dumb World یاد می شود، به یک امپراتور حقیقی اخبار مبدل گردیده است.
english_gold: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.
english_hypothesis: Since its inception, The Onion has transformed from a single print edition, a website with 5,000,000 unique monthly visitors, personalized ads, a 24‑hour news network, podcasts, and a recently released global atlas called Our Dumb World, into a true news empire.

source: تعداد زیادی از نویسندگان آنها بالای نمایش های اخبار تمسخر آمیز جون ستیوارت و ستیفن کولبرت تاثیر زیاد داشتند.
english_gold: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.
english_hypothesis: A large number of their writers were heavily influenced by the satirical news shows of John Stewart and Stephen Colbert.

source: ال گور و جنرال تامی فرانکس اتفاقاً سرخط های دلخواه خود را به سرعت خواندند (گور هنگامیکه The Onion گزارش داد که او و تیپر بعد از شکست انتخابات سال 2000 کالج اش بهترین رابطه جنسی داشتند).
english_gold: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).
english_hypothesis: The grave and General Timmy Frank accidentally read their favorite headlines quickly (the grave when The Onion reported that he and Typer, after the 2000 election defeat, had the best sexual relationship at college).

source: دروکگیال ژونگ یک قلعه ای ویران شده و صومعه ای بودایی در قسمت بالایی ناحیه پارو (در قریه فؤندی) است.
english_gold: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).
english_hypothesis: Drukgyal Jong is a ruined castle and a Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro area (in the village of Foudi).

source: گفته شده است که در 1649، ژدرونگ گاوانگ نمگییل قلعه را برای جشن پیروزی خود علیه نیروهای مغول های تبتی ساخت.
english_gold: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.
english_hypothesis: It has been said that in 1649, Zhedrong Gawang Namgiel built the castle to celebrate his victory over the Tibetan Mongol forces.

source: در 1951، برخی آثار دروکگیال ژونگ مانند تصویر ژدرونگ گاوانگ نمگی یل در یک آتش سوزی از بین رفتند.
english_gold: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
english_hypothesis: In 1951, some works of Drokgyal Jong, such as the painting of Jzdrong Gawang Nami Yil, were destroyed in a fire.

source: بعد از آتش سوزی، قلعه نگهداری و محافظت شد، و همچنان یکی از جذابه های شورانگیز بوتان باقی ماند.
english_gold: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.
english_hypothesis: After the fire, the castle was preserved and protected, and it remained one of Bhutan’s most exciting attractions.

source: معبد آرتمیس در ایفسوس در 21 جولای 356 قبل از میلاد در یک مراسم آتش سوزی توسط هروستراتوس ویران شد.
english_gold: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.
english_hypothesis: The Artemis Temple in Ephesus was destroyed by a fire ritual on July 21, 356 BCE by Herostratus.

source: طبق داستان، انگیزه او باعث شهرت تمام عیارش شده بود. افیسیان ها خشمگین اعلام کردن که نام هروستراتوس هرگز ثبت نخواهد شد.
english_gold: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.
english_hypothesis: According to the story, his motivation had made him a complete celebrity. The Ephesians angrily declared that the name Herostratus would never be recorded.

source: استرابو مورخ یونانی بعداٌ به این نام اشاره کرد که امروزه ما آن را می شناسیم. معبد در همان شبی که اسکندر مقدونی متولد شد ویران شد.
english_gold: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.
english_hypothesis: The Greek historian Strabo later referred to this name that we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

source: اسکندر بحیث پادشاه، هزینه بازسازی معبد را پیشنهاد داد، اما پیشنهاد او رد شد. بعدها، پس از مرگ اسکندر، آن معبد در سال 323 قبل از میلاد بازسازی شد.
english_gold: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
english_hypothesis: Alexander, as king, proposed the cost of rebuilding the temple, but his proposal was rejected. Later, after Alexander's death, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BC.

source: نقاشی های دیواری یا خط خطی ناخواسته به عنوان دیوار نگاری شناخته می شود.
english_gold: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.
english_hypothesis: Wall paintings or unintended line drawings are known as wall art.

source: در حالی که این پدیده از پدیده مدرن بودن فاصله دارد، احتمالاً اکثر مردم آن را با تخریب اموال عمومی و خصوصی با استفاده از رنگ اسپری توسط جوانان ارتباط می دهند.
english_gold: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.
english_hypothesis: While this phenomenon is distant from modernity, most people likely associate it with the destruction of public and private property using spray paint by youths.

source: با این حال، امروزه هنرمندان گرافیتی تثبیت شده، رویدادهای گرافیتی و دیوارهای "قانونی" وجود دارند. نقاشی های دیواری در این زمینه اغلب شبیه آثار هنری هستند تا برچسب های ناخوانا.
english_gold: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.
english_hypothesis: However, today there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events, and "legal" walls. Murals in this context are often more like works of art than illegible tags.

source: برخی از کشورها حتی برای اولین ارتکاب جرم مجازات های شدیدتری دارند؛ این موارد می تواند شامل بیش از 10 سال حبس یا اعدام باشد.
english_gold: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.
english_hypothesis: Some countries even impose harsher penalties for a first offense; these can include more than 10 years of imprisonment or the death penalty.

source: در خارج از ساوانا، مشکل است برای یک پستاندار با سیستم هاضمه مانند انسان نیازهای امینو اسید خود را از منابع گیاهی موجوده برآورده کند.
english_gold: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
english_hypothesis: Outside the savannah, it is difficult for a mammal with a human-like digestive system to meet its amino acid needs from available plant sources.

source: در دسترس ترین منابع گیاهی، پروتین های قابل دسترس در برگ ها و حبوبات بودند، اما هضم آنها برای پستاندارانی مانند ما سخت است مگر اینکه پخته شوند.
english_gold: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
english_hypothesis: The most readily available plant sources were the accessible proteins in leaves and legumes, but their digestion is difficult for mammals like us unless they are cooked.

source: در مقابل، غذاهای حیوانی (مورچه ها، موریانه ها، تخم مرغ) نه تنها به راحتی قابل هضم هستند، بلکه پروتین هایی با مقدار زیادی را فراهم میکنند که حاوی تمام امینو اسید ضروری هستند.
english_gold: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
english_hypothesis: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) are not only easily digestible, but also provide large amounts of protein that contain all essential amino acids.

source: با در نظر گرفتن همه چیز، ما نباید تعجب کنیم اگر اجداد خودمان "مشکل پروتین" خود را تا حدودی به همان روشی که شامپانزده های موجود در ساوانا امروز حل میکنند، حل کرده اند.
english_gold: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
english_hypothesis: Considering everything, we should not be surprised if our ancestors have solved their "protein problem" to some extent in the same way that the chimpanzees in today's savanna do.

source: شیرها اجتماعی ترین گربه ها هستند که در گروه های بزرگی به نام غرور زنده گی می کنند.
english_gold: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
english_hypothesis: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.

source: پرایدها از یک تا سه نر بالغ به علاوه سه ماده و ماهی تشکیل شده است.
english_gold: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
english_hypothesis: Pride(s) consist of one to three mature males plus three females and fish.

source: زنان معمولاً با یکدیگر دارای خویشاوند نزدیک هستند و دارای خانواده ای بزرگ از خواهران و دختران هستند.
english_gold: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
english_hypothesis: Women usually have close relatives with each other and have a large family of sisters and daughters.

source: طعمه شیر مانند گرگ یا طعمه سگ رفتار می کند، حیوانات به طرز شگفت انگیزی از نظر رفتار شبیه شیرها هستند (اما نه پشک های بزرگ دیگر) و همچنین برای طعمه خود بسیار کشنده هستند.
english_gold: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
english_hypothesis: The lion’s prey behaves like that of a wolf or a dog; animals are astonishingly similar to lions in behavior (but not other large cats) and are also very lethal to their prey.

source: فاصله بین پوینت ماریون و فیرمونت چالش برانگیزترین شرایط دریوری را در بزرگراه بوفالو-پیتسبورگ به وجود می آورد و اغلب از ساحه جدا افتاده جنگل پشت سر عبور می کند.
english_gold: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
english_hypothesis: The distance between Point Marion and Fort Mitchell creates the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo‑Pittsburgh highway, and it often passes behind the detached forest area.

source: اگر به دریوری در جاده های روستایی عادت ندارید، حواس خود را جمع کنید: شیب های تند، خطوط باریک و پیچ های تیز فراوان است.
english_gold: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
english_hypothesis: If you are not used to driving on rural roads, keep your wits about you: steep slopes, narrow lanes, and many sharp turns abound.

source: محدودیت های سرعت نصب شده به شکل قابل توجهی کمتر از بخش های قبلی و بعدی است - معمولاً 35-40 مایل در ساعت (56-64 کیلومتر در ساعت)- و رعایت دقیق از آنها حتی مهمتر از موارد دیگر است.
english_gold: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
english_hypothesis: The speed limits set are significantly lower than those in the previous and next sections—usually 35–40 miles per hour (56–64 kilometers per hour)—and strict compliance with them is even more important than other matters.

source: با این حال، عجیب است که خدمات تلیفون موبایل در اینجا بسیار قوی تر از سایر نقاط مسیر، به عنوان مثال پنسیلوانیا وایلدز است.
english_gold: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
english_hypothesis: However, it is strange that mobile phone service here is much stronger than in other parts of the route, for example Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: دیدن مکان ها و حیات وحش گالاپاگوس بهتر است مانند چارلز داروین در سال 1835 با قایق انجام شود.
english_gold: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.
english_hypothesis: Seeing the places and wildlife of the Galápagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did in 1835.

source: بیش از 60 کشتی تفریحی در آب های گالاپاگوس رفت و آمد می کنند – این کشتی ها بین 8 تا 100 مسافر ظرفیت دارند.
english_gold: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
english_hypothesis: More than 60 pleasure boats come and go in the waters of the Galápagos – these boats have a capacity of between 8 and 100 passengers.

source: اکثر مردم جای خود را از قبل رزرو می کنند (زیرا قایق ها در فصل پر آب معمولاً پر هستند).
english_gold: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
english_hypothesis: Most people reserve their spot in advance (because boats are usually full during the high season).

source: مطمئن گردید نماینده ای که از طریق آن رزرو می کنید متخصص گالاپاگوس است و دانش مناسبی از انواع مختلف کشتی ها دارد.
english_gold: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
english_hypothesis: It was confirmed that the representative you book through is a Galapagos specialist and has adequate knowledge of various types of boats.

source: این امر مطابقت علایق و/یا محدودیت های خاص شما با مناسبترین کشتی را تضمین می کند.
english_gold: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
english_hypothesis: This ensures that your interests and/or specific constraints match the most suitable boat.

source: سفر و یادگیری به شکل فزاینده ای یکی از پرطرفدارترین گزینه ها برای کسانی است که سالی خالی را پلان دارند.
english_gold: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
english_hypothesis: Travel and learning are increasingly among the most popular options for those who have a free year planned.

source: این موضوع بخصوص در میان محصلینی که مکتب را تمام می کنند رایج است، و به آنها اجازه می دهد پیش از ورود به پوهنتون بدون اینکه تحصیلاتشان را به خطر بیندازند یک سال را در فراغت باشند.
english_gold: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
english_hypothesis: This practice is especially common among students who are finishing school, and it allows them to spend a year in leisure before entering university without jeopardizing their studies.

source: در بسیاری موارد، ثبت نام در کورسی یک ساله در خارج در حقیقت می تواند شانس هایتان برای ورود به تحصیلات عالی در کشورتان را افزایش دهد.
english_gold: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
english_hypothesis: In many cases, enrolling in a one‑year course abroad can actually increase your chances of gaining admission to higher education in your home country.

source: معمولاً ثبت نام در این برنامه های آموزشی شامل فیس می گردد.
english_gold: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
english_hypothesis: Registration in these training programs usually incurs a fee.

source: بیشتر سفرهای تفریحی خاص بالتیک اقامتی اضافی را در سن پترزبورگ، روسیه دارند.
english_gold: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
english_hypothesis: Most special Baltic leisure trips include an additional stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.

source: این بدان معناست که می توانید هنگام بازگشت برای چند روز مکمل از این شهر تاریخی دیدن نموده و شب را در کشتی بخوابید.
english_gold: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
english_hypothesis: This means that you can visit the historic city for a few days and spend the night on a boat.

source: اگر برای رفتن به ساحل فقط از گشت های تفریحی کشتی استفاده می کنید، ضرورت به ویزه جداگانه نخواهید داشت (2009 به بعد).
english_gold: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
english_hypothesis: If you only use pleasure cruises to go to the beach, you will not need a separate visa (from 2009 onwards).

source: بعضی از تورهای گردشگری شهر برلین، آلمان را در بروشورها قرار داده اند. همانطور که در نقشه بالا مشاهده می کنید برلین نزدیک به دریا نمی باشد و بازدید از این شهر در هزینه گردش شامل نگردیده است.
english_gold: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
english_hypothesis: Some of the Berlin city tour packages have listed Germany in their brochures. As you can see in the map above, Berlin is not close to the sea, and visiting this city is not included in the travel cost.

source: 1:15 a.m. شنبه، به گفته شاهدین، بس از یک چراغ سبز میگذشت که یک موتر از جلو اش دور زد.
english_gold: At 1:15 a.m. Saturday, according to witnesses, the bus was going through a green light when the car made a turn in front of it.
english_hypothesis: Saturday at 1:15 a.m., according to witnesses, it was just a green light when a car passed in front of it.

source: خوشبختانه به من هیچ چیزی رخ نداده است، مگر من یک صحنه ترسناک را دیدم، طوریکه مردم کوشش میکردند تا برای بیرون رفتن کلکین ها را بشکند.
english_gold: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.
english_hypothesis: Fortunately nothing has happened to me, except that I saw a scary scene where people were trying to break the clutches to get out.

source: مردم پنجره ها را با چوکی میزدند، مگر کلکین ها غیرقابل شکستن بودند.
english_gold: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.
english_hypothesis: People hit the windows with a stick, but the klakins were unbreakable.

source: یکی از افراد زنده مانده فرانشیک کوال گفت، "یکی از پنجره ها بالاخره شکست، و آنها شروع به خارج شدن از کلکین کردند".
english_gold: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.
english_hypothesis: One of the survivors, Franšik Qol, said, “One of the windows finally broke, and they started to exit the cellar.”

source: موضوع در 1 جنوری زمانیکه ده ها تن از ساکنین محلی شروع به شکایت به دفتر پوست اوبانزاوا کرد اینکه آنها کارت های مروج و همیشه سال نو خویش را دریافت نکرده اند شروع شد.
english_gold: The issue started on January 1st when dozens of local residents started complaining to the Obanazawa Post Office that they hadn't received their traditional and regular New Year cards.
english_hypothesis: The issue began on January 1 when dozens of local residents started complaining to the Obanzaawa skin office that they had not received their promotional cards and their New Year greetings.

source: دیروز، دفتر پوست عذرخواهی خود را به شهروندان نشر نموده و رسانه ها بعد از کشف اینکه پسر بیشتر از 600 سند پوستی بشمول 429 کارت پوستی سال نو را پنهان نموده بود، که به دریافت کنندگان که مد نظر بودند نرسیده بودند.
english_gold: Yesterday, the post office released their apology to citizens and the media after discovering that the boy had hidden more than 600 postal documents, including 429 New Year postcards, which weren't delivered to their intended recipients.
english_hypothesis: Yesterday, the Office of Skin published its apology to the citizens and the media after discovering that the son had hidden more than 600 skin documents, including 429 New Year skin cards, which had not reached the intended recipients.

source: مادر گفت، "ما همه مان شوکه شده بودیم".
english_gold: "We were all simply in shock," the mother stated.
english_hypothesis: Mother said, "We were all shocked."

source: زمانیکه پرسیده شد که پدر چه گفت، او گفت که "او هیچ چیز نمیتوانست بگوید – او فقط انجا ایستاده پلک میزد."
english_gold: When asked what the father said, she answered "He couldn't say a thing - he just stood there blinking."
english_hypothesis: When asked what the father said, he replied that he could not say anything – he was just standing there blinking.

source: مسافرانی که در حال برنامه ریزی برای تغییر جنسیت در خارج از کشور هستند، باید اطمینان حاصل کنند مدارکی معتبر برای سفر برگشت دارند.
english_gold: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
english_hypothesis: Travelers who are planning to undergo gender transition abroad must ensure they have valid documents for their return trip.

source: تمایل دولت ها برای صدور پاسپورت با جنسیت نامعین (X) یا اسناد به روز شده برای مطابقت با نام دلخواه و جنسیت متفاوت است.
english_gold: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
english_hypothesis: Governments tend to issue passports with an unspecified gender (X) or updated documents to match a chosen name and a different gender.

source: تمایل دولت های خارجی برای احترام به این اسناد نیز به همان اندازه متغیر است.
english_gold: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
english_hypothesis: The tendency of foreign governments to respect these documents is also as variable.

source: افراد تراجنسیتی پیش از عملیات نباید انتظار داشته باشند که عبور از اسکنرها با حفظ حریم خصوصی و حفظ شأن آنها صورت پذیرد.
english_gold: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
english_hypothesis: Transgender individuals should not expect that passing through scanners before the operation will preserve their privacy and dignity.

source: غذای هنگی در گودالی داغ داخل زمین پخته می شود.
english_gold: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.
english_hypothesis: The Hangi food is cooked in a hot pit inside the ground.

source: این گودال یا با سنگ های داغ ناشی از آتش گرم می شود، یا در برخی نقاط حرارت زمین گرمایی باعث می شود مناطق زمین به طور طبیعی داغ شوند.
english_gold: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.
english_hypothesis: This pit is either heated by hot stones from fire, or in some places geothermal heat causes the ground to become naturally hot.

source: هنگی اغلب برای پخت شامی سنتی به سبک کباب استفاده می شود.
english_gold: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.
english_hypothesis: Hangi is often used for cooking traditional shami in the kebab style.

source: چندین مکان در روتوروا هنگی زمین گرمایی را ارائه می دهند، در حالی که سایر هنگی ها را می توان در کرایست چرچ، ولینگتون و جاهای دیگر خورد.
english_gold: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.
english_hypothesis: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal pools, while other pools can be found in Christchurch, Wellington, and elsewhere.

source: Cinque Terre که به معنی پنج سرزمین است، از پنج روستای ساحلی کوچک ریماگیور، مانارولا، کورنگلیا، ویرنازا و مونتیروسو واقع در قسمت لاتین لیگوریا شکل یافته است.
english_gold: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.
english_hypothesis: Cinque Terre, which means "five lands," is formed from five small coastal villages—Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza, and Monterosso—located in the Ligurian part of Italy.

source: آنها در لست میراث های جهانی یونسکو قرار گرفته اند.
english_gold: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
english_hypothesis: They have been placed on UNESCO's World Heritage List.

source: طی قرن ها، مردم بالکن هایی بهاری را با دقت بر روی چشم انداز ناهموار و شیب دار صخره هایی که مشرف به دریا هستند ساخته اند.
english_gold: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.
english_hypothesis: Over the centuries, people have carefully built spring balconies overlooking the uneven, steep rock faces that overlook the sea.

source: عدم انکشاف متحد قابل مشاهده جزیی از جذابیت آن است. مسیرها، قطارها و قایق ها قریه جات را به هم متصل نموده و موترها از بیرون نمی توانند به آنجا برسند.
english_gold: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
english_hypothesis: The lack of unified development is a noticeable part of its charm. Roads, trains, and boats connect the villages together, and cars from outside cannot reach there.

source: محمد عمیقاً به مسایلی فراتر از این زندگی روزمره علاقه مند بود. او برای اندیشیدن در غاری که بنام <حرا> در کوه "نور" (شرونی) معروف شد رفت و آمد می کرد.
english_gold: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
english_hypothesis: Mohammad was deeply interested in matters beyond everyday life. He would go back and forth to contemplate in a cave called <Harā> in the mountain "Noor" (Shoruni).

source: خود غار که از زمان ها سالم مانده است، نمای خیلی واضحی از گرایشات معنوی محمد به دست می دهد.
english_gold: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
english_hypothesis: The cave itself, which has remained intact since ancient times, provides a very clear picture of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.

source: این غار که در قسمت بالای یکی از کوه های شمال مکه قرار دارد، کاملاً از دیگر نقاط جهان مجزا بنظر میرسد.
english_gold: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
english_hypothesis: This cave, located in the upper part of one of the mountains north of Mecca, appears completely separate from other points in the world.

source: چیزی جز آسمان صاف و زیبای بالا و کوه های متعدد اطراف آن دیده نمی شود. خیلی کم از این دنیا را می توان از داخل غار دید یا شنید.
english_gold: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
english_hypothesis: Only a clear, beautiful sky above and many surrounding mountains can be seen. Very few people can see or hear this world from inside a cave.

source: از آنجا که مونته ویدئو در جنوب خط استوا قرار دارد، زمانی که در نیمکره شمالی زمستان است در آنجا تابستان می باشد و برعکس.
english_gold: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
english_hypothesis: Since Montevideo is located in the southern hemisphere, when it is winter in the northern hemisphere it is summer there, and vice versa.

source: مونته ویدئو در منطقه نیمه گرمسیری قرار دارد. معمولاً در ماه های تابستان دما 30+ درجه سانتی گراد است.
english_gold: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
english_hypothesis: Monté Video is located in a subtropical region. The temperature is usually above 30 degrees Celsius in the summer months.

source: زمستان می تواند به طرز فریبنده ای سرد باشد: درجه حرارت به ندرت به زیر صفر می رسد، اما ترکیب باد و رطوبت باعث می شود سرما نسبت به درجه نمایش داده شده روی دماسنج سردتر احساس گردد.
english_gold: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
english_hypothesis: Winter can be deceptively cold: the temperature rarely drops below zero, but the combination of wind and humidity makes the cold feel colder than the number shown on the thermometer.

source: هیچ فصل بارانی و خشک خاصی وجود ندارد: میزان بارندگی در طول سال تقریباً یکسان است.
english_gold: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
english_hypothesis: There is no particular rainy or dry season: the amount of rainfall is almost the same throughout the year.

source: ورزش های برفی در سراشیبی، که شامل اسکی و اسنوبورد است، ورزش های پرطرفداری هستند که شامل سر خوردن روی زمین های پوشیده از برف با اسکی یا اسنوبورد چسبیده به پاهایتان است.
english_gold: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
english_hypothesis: Skiing and snowboarding on slopes are popular sports that involve sliding across snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.

source: اسکی یک فعالیت اصلی مسافرتی با تعداد زیادی علاقمند است، گاهی اوقات به عنوان "بوم اسکی"، پلان ریزی برای تمامی تعطیلات حول محور اسکی در یک مکان خاص شناخته میشود.
english_gold: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
english_hypothesis: Skiing is a major travel activity with many enthusiasts, and it is sometimes referred to as a "ski base," where planning for all holidays around skiing in a specific location is known.

source: نظریه اسکی سواری بسیار قدیمی است - نگاره های مغاره ای که اسکی بازان را نمایش میدهد به 5000 سال قبل از میلاد باز می گردد!
english_gold: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
english_hypothesis: The theory of ski riding is very old – the cave paintings that depict skiers date back to 5,000 BCE!

source: اسکی در سراشیبی به عنوان یک سپورت حداقل به قرن 17 برمی گردد و در سال 1861 اولین کلب اسکی تفریحی توسط نروژی ها در استرالیا افتتاح شد.
english_gold: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
english_hypothesis: Skiing on slopes as a sport dates back at least to the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.

source: نوشیدنی های الکلی را در حد اعتدال بنوشید. مشروبات الکلی تاثیر متفاوت روی افراد می گذارد، و دانستن حد خود بسیار مهم است.
english_gold: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
english_hypothesis: Drink alcoholic beverages in moderation. Alcoholic drinks affect people differently, and knowing your limits is very important.

source: کازینوها معمولاً تلاش بسیاری می کنند تا زمان و پول صرف شده توسط مهمانان را به حداکثر برسانند. معمولا کلکین و ساعت وجود ندارند، و یافتن خروجی ها دشوار است.
english_gold: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
english_hypothesis: Casino operators usually try hard to maximize the time and money spent by guests. They typically have no clocks or watches, and finding exits is difficult.

source: آنها معمولاً پیشنهادات غذایی، نوشیدنی و سرگرمی خاص دارند تا مهمانان را در خلق و خوی خوب نگاه داشته و در تعمیر حفظ دارند.
english_gold: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
english_hypothesis: They usually offer special food, drinks, and entertainment to keep guests in a good mood and maintain them.

source: برخی از مکان ها نوشیدنی های الکلی رایگان ارائه می دهند. با این حال، مستی قضاوت را مختل می کند و تمام قماربازان خوب اهمیت هوشیار بودن را می دانند.
english_gold: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
english_hypothesis: Some places offer free alcoholic drinks. However, drunkenness impairs judgment, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying alert.
